summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime as a zip from GitHub, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file using hex-named identifiers, a shuffled/rotated string array (`n7gIxM` / `WV8StW`), and a codepoint-arithmetic string decoder (`hc1jfK9`). The file is not referenced by any TypeScript sources, tsconfig entries, or documentation and is not part of the declared React component library build. Installing the package therefore fetches an alternate language runtime and auto-executes an obfuscated bundled payload on the installer's machine, bypassing Node-based inspection. A UI-components library has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an undocumented obfuscated sibling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
